dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - June 30, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**MLB Recap: Tuesday's Action**

The Chicago White Sox dominated the Baltimore Orioles 9-3 behind a strong team effort. Junior Perez led the charge with 1 hit, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. Erick Fedde earned the win, while Tyler Schweitzer secured the save. In the Texas Rangers' 4-2 win over the Cleveland Guardians, Jacob deGrom was impressive with 7 scoreless innings and 9 strikeouts. Joc Pederson homered twice for the Rangers.

In the Philadelphia Phillies' 8-0 shutout of the Pittsburgh Pirates, Cristopher Sánchez pitched 7 scoreless innings with 9 strikeouts. Trea Turner homered twice for the Phillies. The Washington Nationals cruised to an 8-1 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Cade Cavalli tossing 7 scoreless innings and striking out 13. CJ Abrams homered for the Nationals.

The St. Louis Cardinals edged the Atlanta Braves 5-3 behind Matthew Liberatore's 5 scoreless innings and 9 strikeouts. Nathan Church homered for the Cardinals. The Tampa Bay Rays pounded the Kansas City Royals 10-4, with Bobby Witt Jr. hitting 2 home runs for the Royals. In the Milwaukee Brewers' 7-2 win over the Cincinnati Reds, Brandon Sproat pitched 5.1 scoreless innings with 7 strikeouts. Sal Stewart homered for the Brewers.

The Chicago Cubs outlasted the San Diego Padres 7-9, with Dansby Swanson hitting 2 home runs for the Cubs. The Houston Astros edged the Minnesota Twins 6-4, with Yordan Alvarez hitting 1 home run and 4 RBIs for the Astros. The Miami Marlins routed the Colorado Rockies 14-3, with Eury Pérez pitching 5.1 scoreless innings and striking out 8. Javier Sanoja homered for the Marlins.

The Los Angeles Dodgers defeated the Athletics 9-3, with Justin Wrobleski tossing 7 scoreless innings and striking out 11. Tommy Edman homered for the Dodgers. The Seattle Mariners crushed the Los Angeles Angels 8-3, with José Soriano pitching 5 scoreless innings and striking out 9. Colt Emerson homered for the Mariners. The Arizona Diamondbacks dominated the San Francisco Giants 8-2, with Ketel Marte hitting 1 home run and 3 RBIs for the Diamondbacks.
